sentences.text: Yantaloong is likely the first turiasaurian sauropod discovered in China and East Asia.
The genus Yantaloong was described by Zhang and colleagues.
Its type locality is the Zhanghe Formation in China.
The animal shows a combination of derived features seen in dicraeosaurines and titanosaurs together with primitive characteristics of basal eusauropods.
The authors placed Yantaloong within Turiasauria because their analysis gave the highest stability for that position.
Yantaloong lived in the Middle Jurassic period.
Alternative analyses have suggested it could be a non-neosauropod eusauropod outside traditional Turiasauria or even a member of Neosauropoda, though these ideas are less supported.
